hook.text: In 2015, Volkswagen was caught cheating on emissions tests—on 11 million cars worldwide.

buildup.text: VW's diesel engines had software that detected test conditions and reduced emissions only during tests.

discovery.text: On real roads, those cars emitted up to 40 times the legal limit of nitrogen oxides.

twist.text: VW had marketed these cars as 'clean diesel.' The fraud ran for at least six years.

climax.text: The scandal cost VW over $30 billion in fines and killed the clean diesel movement overnight.

punchline.text: Dieselgate accelerated the shift to electric.

quiz.question: How many VW cars were affected by Dieselgate?
